summary.en: Canonical pattern for adding Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on via OAuth2 Authorization Code flow plus an app-issued JWT session. Language-agnostic, with Python and TypeScript demos.
summary.zh: 为应用添加 Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID 单点登录的标准范式：基于 OAuth2 授权码流程并签发应用自有的 JWT 会话。与语言无关，附带 Python 和 TypeScript 示例。
